paragraphs.en: Corpus-level long-context reasoning requires agents to acquire and integrate evidence across document collections that exceed their context windows. Existing agent harnesses enable incremental access to these corpora, but acquired evidence and evolving conclusions often remain entangled in a growing interaction history. This implicit state management can lead to two coupled failure modes: unbounded exploration, where retrieval expands the interaction history without resolving decision-relevant information gaps, and evidence-state drift, where previously acquired evidence or subsequent corrections fail to inform the current conclusion. We present LongHarness , a model-agnostic harness that makes the interaction between acquired evidence and evolving conclusions explicit. Its core mechanism, Evidence–Conclusion Coevolution , uses unresolved conclusions to guide exploration toward missing information, while newly acquired evidence strengthens or revises the conclusions that directed the search. LongHarness couples this process with Evidence Lifecycle Management , which keeps accumulated evidence current and traceable throughout the interaction. Together, these mechanisms focus retrieval on remaining information needs and keep conclusions aligned with current evidence. We evaluate LongHarness on OfficeQA Pro V1 and V2, AA-LCR, and LongBench v2 using GLM-5.3-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash. Compared with direct reasoning using the same backbone, LongHarness improves GLM-5.3-Flash exact match on OfficeQA Pro from 15.8% to 60.2% on V1 and from 4.4% to 61.1% on V2. Against state-of-the-art agent harnesses, it surpasses Claude Code by 12.0 percentage points on V1 and Codex by 18.9 points on V2. With Qwen3.8-Flash, LongHarness reaches 61.7% on V1, outperforming Claude Code by 8.3 points and Codex by 12.0 points.
paragraphs.zh: 语料库级别的长上下文推理要求智能体能够获取并整合来自超出其上下文窗口范围的文档集合中的证据。 现有的智能体工具支持对这类语料库进行增量访问，但已获取的证据和不断演变的结论往往仍纠缠在日益增长的交互历史中。 这种隐式的状态管理可能导致两种相互关联的故障模式：无边界探索（检索过程会扩展交互历史，却无法解决与决策相关的信息缺口）以及证据-状态漂移（先前获取的证据或后续修正无法影响当前结论）。 我们提出了 LongHarness——一种模型无关的工具，它将已获取的证据与不断演变的结论之间的相互作用显性化。 其核心机制“证据-结论协同演化”利用未解决的结论引导探索以定位缺失信息，而新获取的证据则会强化或修正指导搜索的结论。 LongHarness 将这一过程与“证据生命周期管理”相结合，确保在整个交互过程中积累的证据始终保持最新且可追溯。 这些机制共同作用，使检索聚焦于尚未满足的信息需求，并让结论与当前证据保持一致。 我们使用 GLM-5.3-Flash 和 Qwen3.8-Flash，在 OfficeQA Pro V1 和 V2、AA-LCR 以及 LongBench v2 上对 LongHarness 进行了评估。 与直接使用相同基础模型进行推理相比，LongHarness 将 GLM-5.3-Flash 在 OfficeQA Pro V1 上的精确匹配率从 15.8% 提升至 60.2%，在 V2 上则从 4.4% 提升至 61.1%。 与当前最先进的智能体工具相比，它在 V1 上比 Claude Code 高出 12.0 个百分点，在 V2 上比 Codex 高出 18.9 个百分点。 使用 Qwen3.8-Flash 时，LongHarness 在 V1 上的准确率达到 61.7%，比 Claude Code 高出 8.3 个百分点，比 Codex 高出 12.0 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Real-world document questions often require evidence scattered across large, evolving document collections. Corpus-level long-context reasoning requires agents to locate and integrate this evidence even when the collection exceeds their context windows. Longer windows expand the material available within a single invocation ( Gemini Team, 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Shang et al., 2025 ) , but models remain sensitive to evidence position and distractors even when the relevant content fits ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Hsieh et al., 2024 ; Ling et al., 2025 ; Zhuang et al., 2025a ) . Agents must therefore search selectively, read relevant passages, and accumulate evidence across multiple interactions. As these interactions unfold, the challenge extends from finding evidence to keeping it usable, revising it when needed, and carrying it into the final decision.
paragraphs.zh: 现实世界中的文档问题通常需要证据分散在庞大且不断变化的文档集合中。 语料库级别的长上下文推理要求智能体能够定位并整合这些证据，即使文档集合超出了其上下文窗口范围。 更长的窗口扩大了单次调用中可用的材料（Gemini Team, 2024；Yang et al., 2025b；Shang et al., 2025），但即使相关内容完全在窗口范围内，模型仍然对证据的位置和干扰因素高度敏感（Liu et al., 2024；Hsieh et al., 2024；Ling et al., 2025；Zhuang et al., 2025a）。 因此，智能体必须选择性搜索、阅读相关段落，并在多次交互中积累证据。 随着这些交互的展开，挑战从寻找证据扩展到了保持证据的有效性、在必要时修订证据，并将其带入最终决策过程。

paragraphs.en: We view this process at three levels. Evidence retrieval (Level 1) locates relevant passages while filtering distractors. Evidence editing (Level 2) selects, reconciles, and revises retrieved content. Evidence transformation (Level 3) turns the resulting evidence into an answer. Training methods supervise retrieval trajectories and memory edits ( Lin et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Gao and Marttinen, 2026 ) , while agent harnesses enable adaptive document access and persistent storage ( Cao et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Lee et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Packer et al., 2024 ; Karten et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) . These advances strengthen evidence acquisition and maintenance, yet the transition from accumulated evidence to an evolving conclusion often remains implicit. The conclusions that determine what to search for next and what answer to produce remain embedded in session history, free-form notes, or transient reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从三个层面来看待这一过程。 证据检索（第一层）负责定位相关段落，同时过滤干扰信息。 证据编辑（第二层）负责选择、协调和修改检索到的内容。 证据转换（第三层）将最终形成的证据转化为答案。 训练方法用于监督检索路径和记忆编辑（Lin et al., 2026b；Chen et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2025；Gao and Marttinen, 2026），而智能体利用机制则支持对文档的自适应访问和持久化存储（Cao et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2023；Lee et al., 2024；Zhao et al., 2024；Packer et al., 2024；Karten et al., 2026；Yu et al., 2026）。 这些进步增强了证据的获取与维持能力，但将积累的证据转化为不断演进的结论这一过程通常仍不明确。 决定下一步搜索内容和生成何种答案的结论，仍然隐藏在会话历史、自由格式笔记或临时推理过程中。

paragraphs.en: At corpus scale, this implicit transition can lead to two coupled failure modes. (i) Unbounded exploration occurs when retrieval continues without resolving decision-relevant information gaps, potentially exhausting the interaction budget. (ii) Evidence-state drift occurs when previously acquired evidence or later corrections become disconnected from subsequent reasoning, leaving the final decision based on stale or incomplete evidence. These failures can reinforce each other as drift obscures which information needs have already been resolved, prompting further retrieval that expands the history and makes relevant evidence harder to recover.
paragraphs.zh: 在语料库规模上，这种隐式转换可能导致两种相互耦合的失效模式。 (i) 当检索过程持续进行却无法解决与决策相关的信息缺口时，就会发生无边界探索，这可能会耗尽交互预算。 (ii) 当先前获取的证据或后续修正与后续推理脱节时，就会发生证据状态漂移，导致最终决策基于过时或不完整的证据。 这些失效可能相互强化：漂移会掩盖哪些信息需求已经得到满足，从而引发更多检索，这不仅延长了历史记录，还使相关证据更难被找回。

paragraphs.en: We introduce LongHarness , a model-agnostic harness that maintains source-linked evidence and evolving conclusions as coupled persistent states. Unresolved conclusion gaps guide subsequent search and reading, while accepted evidence informs revisions to the conclusions and their remaining gaps. Its core mechanism, Evidence–Conclusion Coevolution , uses unresolved conclusions to guide exploration toward missing information, while newly acquired evidence strengthens or revises the conclusions that directed the search. By making the remaining information needs explicit, this feedback directs retrieval toward gaps that matter to the decision and helps curb unbounded exploration. LongHarness couples this loop with Evidence Lifecycle Management , which keeps accumulated evidence current and traceable throughout the interaction. The EvidenceBank retains source-linked statements and tracks which remain active throughout the evidence lifecycle, helping reduce evidence-state drift by keeping the basis for subsequent reasoning aligned with the latest findings.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate LongHarness on OfficeQA Pro V1 and V2, AA-LCR, and the LongBench v2 Long subset using GLM-5.3-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash. OfficeQA Pro requires reasoning over roughly 100M tokens in V1, while V2 doubles the corpus and introduces more demanding compositional questions. Compared with direct reasoning using the same backbone, LongHarness raises GLM-5.3-Flash exact match from 15.8% to 60.2% on V1 and from 4.4% to 61.1% on V2. Against state-of-the-art agent harnesses, it surpasses Claude Code by 12.0 percentage points on V1 and Codex by 18.9 points on V2. With Qwen3.8-Flash, it reaches 61.7% on V1, outperforming Claude Code by 8.3 points and Codex by 12.0 points. paragraphs.en: Conclusion-guided exploration. The current Conclusion State guides what the agent searches for and reads next. For each claim, the agent identifies observations that would establish, qualify, or refute it and uses these requirements to formulate queries and select reading scopes. Competing hypotheses motivate searches that distinguish between them, while unresolved gaps direct attention to missing premises. When an observation leaves a gap unresolved, the agent can reformulate the query or broaden the reading scope while keeping further exploration tied to the information needed to advance the conclusion.

paragraphs.en: EvidenceBank mutations defer conclusion updates until the agent observes their results. The policy then revises affected claims and references through optional partial updates, with omitted fields retained. Superseding or retracting evidence does not automatically rewrite dependent conclusions. The controller checks declared evidence references at computation and final submission, while the policy remains responsible for source fidelity and whether the evidence supports its conclusions. Reasoning, actions, and observations accumulate in the history, while evidence and conclusions persist across turns. Final acceptance requires a valid answer structure and references resolving to active evidence and source passages. Resource exhaustion or runtime failure may terminate the episode without an accepted answer. Algorithm 1 in Appendix B.5 summarizes the procedure.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on OfficeQA Pro V1 and V2 ( Opsahl-Ong et al., 2026 ) , AA-LCR ( Artificial Analysis Team, 2026 ) , and the Long subset of LongBench v2 ( Bai et al., 2024 ) , covering both corpus-level reasoning and reasoning over provided contexts. OfficeQA Pro V1 contains 697 Treasury documents totaling approximately 100M tokens, while V2 expands the corpus to 1,435 documents and introduces composite statistical questions that require combining values from multiple sources. Agents receive access to the full corpus without question-specific gold documents, making source discovery part of the task. AA-LCR provides the relevant context for each of its 100 questions, while the LongBench v2 Long subset evaluates reasoning over the benchmark’s longest contexts. We report exact match and accuracy within 5% relative error on OfficeQA Pro, and Exact accuracy on AA-LCR and LongBench v2.

paragraphs.en: We ask whether evidence–conclusion coevolution and evidence lifecycle management are critical to the effectiveness of LongHarness , and examine this question through five ablations in Table 2 . (i) w/o Persistent States removes the EvidenceBank and Conclusion State while retaining interaction history. (ii) w/o Evidence–Conclusion Coevolution retains the EvidenceBank but removes the Conclusion State and its retrieval feedback. (iii) Naive Evidence Accumulation preserves conclusion feedback but permits only append-only evidence updates. (iv) w/o Explicit Conclusion-Guided Exploration retains both states but removes the instructions to guide retrieval using conclusion gaps. (v) Generic Working Notes retains the EvidenceBank and replaces structured conclusions with editable free-text notes that can record conclusions, unresolved questions, and evidence references.
paragraphs.zh: 我们探讨了证据–结论协同演化与证据生命周期管理是否对 LongHarness 的有效性至关重要，并通过表 2 中的五种消融实验对该问题进行了检验。 (i) w/o Persistent States 移除了 EvidenceBank 和 Conclusion State，但保留了交互历史。 (ii) w/o Evidence–Conclusion Coevolution 保留了 EvidenceBank，但移除了 Conclusion State 及其检索反馈。 (iii) Naive Evidence Accumulation 保留了结论反馈，但仅允许对证据进行追加式更新。 (iv) w/o Explicit Conclusion-Guided Exploration 保留了两种状态，但移除了利用结论差距指导检索的指令。 (v) Generic Working Notes 保留了 EvidenceBank，并将结构化结论替换为可编辑的自由文本笔记，用于记录结论、未解决的问题以及证据引用。

paragraphs.en: Removing both persistent states reduces exact match by 4.5 percentage points on V1 and 7.8 on V2, showing that explicit evidence and conclusion states contribute beyond access to the interaction history. Removing the maintained Conclusion State and its retrieval feedback reduces accuracy by 5.3 and 9.4 points. Restricting the EvidenceBank to append-only accumulation yields 56.4% on V1 and 51.1% on V2, corresponding to decreases of 3.8 and 10.0 points. These results support the value of revising and retiring evidence as new observations arrive, even when conclusion feedback is preserved. Removing the explicit conclusion-guided exploration instructions while retaining both persistent states reduces accuracy by 4.5 and 7.8 points, supporting the value of instructing the policy to use conclusion gaps to guide retrieval beyond making those states available. Replacing structured conclusions with generic working notes reduces accuracy by 6.8 and 7.8 points, showing that the full design outperforms editable free-text notes that can also retain conclusions, open questions, and evidence references. All five ablations incur larger losses on V2, consistent with the greater importance of maintaining and reconciling evidence when questions require combining values from multiple sources.
paragraphs.zh: 同时移除持久状态使 V1 上的精确匹配率下降 4.5 个百分点，V2 上下降 7.8 个百分点，这表明显式证据和结论状态的作用超出了对交互历史的访问所能提供的帮助。 移除保留的结论状态及其检索反馈，会使准确率分别下降 5.3 和 9.4 个百分点。 将证据库限制为仅允许追加积累，V1 上的准确率为 56.4%，V2 上为 51.1%，分别对应 3.8 和 10.0 个百分点的下降。 这些结果支持了这样一个观点：即使保留了结论反馈，随着新观察结果的到来，修订和淘汰证据仍然具有价值。 在保留两种持久状态的同时移除显式的结论引导探索指令，会使准确率分别下降 4.5 和 7.8 个百分点，这支持了指导策略利用结论中的空白来引导检索（而不仅仅是提供这些状态）的重要性。 用通用工作笔记取代结构化结论会使准确率分别下降 6.8 和 7.8 个百分点，这表明完整的设计优于可编辑的自由文本笔记，后者虽然也能保留结论、开放问题和证据引用，但效果仍不如前者。 所有五种消融实验在 V2 上都造成了更大的损失，这与在问题需要整合多个来源的值时，维持和协调证据的重要性更高这一情况一致。

paragraphs.en: Post-training supervises evidence acquisition and use. LongRLVR rewards correct identification of evidence chunks ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , LongPAS assigns advantages to reasoning steps ( Peng et al., 2026 ) , and LongR measures document consultation through information gain ( Ping et al., 2026 ) . Training data include key-fact chains ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , distractor-augmented search trajectories ( Lin et al., 2026b ) , capability-aligned task mixtures ( Lv et al., 2026 ) , and verifiable multi-hop or memory-management tasks ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2025 ) . Training also uses agent-generated data and supervision for memory operations. ACC compiles agent trajectories into long-context QA training examples ( Su et al., 2026 ) , AgenticLU distills self-generated clarification trajectories without external teachers ( Zhuang et al., 2025b ) , MAVEN rewards evidence-memory edits ( Gao and Marttinen, 2026 ) , and Memory-R2 credits individual memory operations ( Yan et al., 2026 ) . LongHarness instead couples evidence and conclusions at runtime, linking retrieval, editing, and transformation without additional policy training.

paragraphs.en: ReAct couples reasoning with action ( Yao et al., 2023 ) , recursive language models process context under program control ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and Prime Agent maintains persistent REPL state ( Karten et al., 2026 ) . Codex and Claude Code support long-context reasoning ( Cao et al., 2026 ) ; other harnesses develop bounded long-horizon decomposition, harness maintenance, and persistent memory ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026a ; Packer et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Pan et al., 2026 ) . MemWalker uses memory trees ( Chen et al., 2023 ) , ReadAgent uses gist representations ( Lee et al., 2024 ) , GraphReader uses chunk graphs ( Li et al., 2024 ) , and multi-agent systems coordinate readers ( Zhao et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) . SLIDERS reconciles evidence under an induced schema ( Joshi et al., 2026 ) , ReContext replays found-but-unused evidence ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , and TRACE evaluates tool-augmented reasoning trajectories ( Kim et al., 2026 ) . LedgerMind uses grounding checks and event-triggered repair to address unsupported or inconsistent claims ( Du et al., 2026 ) . However, existing claims can remain grounded while the evidence needed to answer the question is still incomplete. In contrast, LongHarness focuses on corpus-level long-context reasoning, maintaining source-linked evidence alongside evolving conclusions and unresolved information needs. These needs guide subsequent search and reading, while newly acquired evidence informs revisions to conclusions and remaining gaps.

paragraphs.en: We propose LongHarness , a model-agnostic harness that unifies evidence retrieval, editing, and transformation for corpus-level long-context reasoning. Evidence–Conclusion Coevolution couples exploration with conclusion revision, while Evidence Lifecycle Management keeps evidence current and traceable. Evaluations on OfficeQA Pro, AA-LCR, and LongBench v2 show gains with two backbones. With GLM-5.3-Flash, LongHarness exceeds Claude Code by 12.0 percentage points on OfficeQA Pro V1 and Codex by 18.9 points on V2. Ablations support the complementary roles of persistent states, conclusion-guided retrieval, and evidence revision. Trajectory analysis shows similar conditional evidence-use rates across V1 and V2 and a smaller increase in interaction length for LongHarness than for the competing harnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 LongHarness，这是一种模型无关的框架，它将证据检索、编辑和转换统一起来，以实现语料库级别的长上下文推理。 证据–结论协同进化将探索与结论修订相结合，而证据生命周期管理则确保证据保持最新且可追溯。 在 OfficeQA Pro、AA-LCR 和 LongBench v2 上的评估表明，使用两种骨干模型均可取得性能提升。 在使用 GLM-5.3-Flash 时，LongHarness 在 OfficeQA Pro V1 上的表现比 Claude Code 高出 12.0 个百分点，在 V2 上比 Codex 高出 18.9 个百分点。 消融实验证明了持久状态、结论引导的检索以及证据修订之间具有互补作用。 轨迹分析显示，V1 和 V2 中条件性证据使用率相似，且 LongHarness 的交互长度增幅小于其竞争框架。

paragraphs.en: OfficeQA Pro V1 ( Opsahl-Ong et al., 2026 ) contains 133 questions over 697 Treasury documents totaling approximately 100M tokens, while V2 contains 90 questions over an expanded corpus of 1,435 documents. V2 places greater emphasis on composite numerical questions requiring values from different series, versions, or documents. Both versions expose the full corpus without question-specific gold documents, requiring the system to identify the sources needed for each answer. We report exact match, which requires the requested value and format, and accuracy within 5% relative error.
paragraphs.zh: OfficeQA Pro V1（Opsahl-Ong 等人，2026）包含针对 697 份财政部文件的 133 个问题，总规模约为 1 亿个词元；而 V2 则包含针对扩展后的 1,435 份文件语料的 90 个问题。 V2 更强调复合数值问题，这些问题需要来自不同序列、版本或文件的数值。 两个版本均未提供与特定问题对应的标准答案文件，而是完整暴露整个语料，要求系统自行识别每个答案所需的数据来源。 我们报告了精确匹配率（要求同时满足所求数值和格式）以及相对误差在 5% 以内的准确率。

paragraphs.en: We use AA-LCR-1.1 ( Artificial Analysis Team, 2026 ) , 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/datasets/ArtificialAnalysis/AA-LCR which contains 100 questions associated with 30 document sets comprising 234 documents in total, with an average of 99,325 tokens per set. The documents include company and industry reports, government consultations, academic papers, legal and marketing materials, and survey reports. Questions require synthesis, temporal reasoning, conditional logic, or numerical computation across documents rather than direct retrieval from a single passage. Each question supplies its relevant document set, allowing the evaluation to focus on evidence use within the provided context. For direct-reasoning models, we report the AA-LCR scores published by Artificial Analysis in its official evaluation results.

paragraphs.en: LongBench v2 ( Bai et al., 2024 ) contains 503 four-option questions covering single-document QA, multi-document QA, long in-context learning, long-dialogue history understanding, code-repository understanding, and long structured-data understanding. The full benchmark spans contexts of 8K–2M words, most below 128K words. We evaluate the official Long subset of 108 questions, whose contexts in the release used here range from approximately 132K to 1.38M words with a median of 204K words. This subset contains 29 code-repository understanding questions, 26 long in-context learning questions, 24 single-document QA questions, 23 multi-document QA questions, and 6 structured-data understanding questions. Each question provides a long context and four answer options, and performance is measured by exact accuracy on the selected option.

paragraphs.en: This appendix specifies the interaction interface, EvidenceBank operations, state contract, and resource settings used in the reported LongHarness evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录规定了在已报告的 LongHarness 评估中使用的交互接口、EvidenceBank 操作、状态合约和资源设置。

paragraphs.en: The interface distinguishes candidate discovery from source inspection, with search returning candidate locations and read returning source text together with registered references. Search snippets guide subsequent reading, while statements proposed to the EvidenceBank must cite references registered by read .
paragraphs.zh: 该界面将候选发现与来源检查区分开来：搜索操作返回候选位置，而读取操作则返回来源文本以及已注册的引用。 搜索片段为后续阅读提供指引，而提交至证据库的陈述必须引用通过读取操作注册的引用。

sents.zh: 该界面将候选发现与来源检查区分开来：搜索操作返回候选位置，而读取操作则返回来源文本以及已注册的引用。

sents.zh: 搜索片段为后续阅读提供指引，而提交至证据库的陈述必须引用通过读取操作注册的引用。

paragraphs.en: The policy selects one operation per turn, and the controller validates its structure, source references, and resource requirements before execution. Invalid actions return an error observation without modifying the persistent states.
paragraphs.zh: 策略在每个回合中选择一项操作，控制器在执行前会验证其结构、源引用和资源需求。 无效操作会返回一个错误观察结果，而不会修改持久状态。

paragraphs.en: An upsert validates each proposed statement independently by checking that its source references were registered by earlier read actions, so a batch may be partially accepted. The controller validates reference registration, while the policy judges whether the statement faithfully represents its sources.
paragraphs.zh: 上载操作通过检查其来源引用是否由先前的读取操作注册，来独立验证每个拟议的陈述，因此一个批次可能会被部分接受。 控制器负责验证引用的注册情况，而策略则判断该陈述是否忠实反映了其来源。

paragraphs.en: Accepted EvidenceBank entries retain immutable identifiers, and corrections are recorded through revise rather than in-place edits. A non-null replacement creates a corrected active entry and marks the previous entry as superseded, while a null replacement retracts the previous entry without creating a replacement. Superseded and retracted entries remain in the revision record but cannot be cited in compute or final requests. Existing conclusions may retain their references until the policy updates them.
paragraphs.zh: 已接受的 EvidenceBank 条目保留不可更改的标识符，修正通过 revise 操作记录，而非直接修改原条目。 非空替换会创建一个经过修正的有效条目，并将原条目标记为过时；而空替换则会撤销原条目，但不会创建新条目。 过时和已撤销的条目仍保留在修订记录中，但无法在计算或最终请求中被引用。 现有结论可能会保留其引用，直到策略更新这些引用为止。

paragraphs.en: The Conclusion State contains established claims and supported hypotheses linked to active EvidenceBank entries, together with unresolved gaps describing information that could change those conclusions. This representation separates the agent’s current inferences from the source-linked statements maintained in the EvidenceBank .
paragraphs.zh: 结论状态包含已确立的主张和得到支持、并与活跃的“证据库”条目相关联的假设，同时还包括未解决的空白，这些空白描述了可能改变上述结论的信息。 这种表示方式将智能体当前的推论与“证据库”中维护的、与来源相关联的陈述区分开来。

paragraphs.en: When an action updates the EvidenceBank , conclusion revision follows observation of the update result so that claims reference accepted evidence. For other actions, the proposed conclusion update is merged before execution. The complete interaction history remains available alongside the persistent evidence and conclusion states throughout the episode, and final supporting references must resolve to active EvidenceBank entries and their underlying source text. Conclusion updates replace the supplied lists of established claims, hypotheses, or open gaps. Omitted lists remain unchanged. When evidence becomes inactive, transition logs flag affected conclusion references, but the runtime does not automatically delete or rewrite those claims or block subsequent search and reading. Compute and final validate the evidence IDs declared in their requests, rather than all references retained in the Conclusion State . Compute also does not establish that literal operands match the cited source values.
paragraphs.zh: 当某个操作更新证据库时，结论的修订会紧随对更新结果的观察，以确保主张引用的是已被接受的证据。 对于其他操作，拟议的结论更新会在执行前进行合并。 在整个流程期间，完整的交互历史始终与持久化的证据和结论状态一同可用，且最终的支持性引用必须指向活跃的证据库条目及其底层的源文本。 结论的更新将替换所提供的已确立主张、假设或待解决空白项的列表。 被省略的列表保持不变。 当证据变为非活跃状态时，转换日志会标记受影响的结论引用，但运行时不会自动删除或重写这些主张，也不会阻止后续搜索和阅读操作。 应计算并最终验证其请求中声明的证据 ID，而非验证结论状态中保留的所有引用。 计算过程也不会确认字面操作数是否与所引用的源值相匹配。

paragraphs.en: At each step, the policy receives the system instructions and task specification, followed by the complete interaction history and the current runtime state. The history includes all previous reasoning, actions, and tool observations. Historical observations are retained in full rather than replaced with summaries or placeholders. The runtime state presents the EvidenceBank , Conclusion State , and remaining resource budgets. These explicit states provide an organized record of acquired evidence and unresolved information needs alongside the full interaction history. The cumulative read budget counts only source text returned by the read operation across the episode.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个步骤中，策略都会接收系统指令和任务说明，随后是完整的交互历史和当前的运行时状态。 历史记录包含所有先前的推理、操作和工具观察结果。 历史观察结果会被完整保留，而不是用摘要或占位符替代。 运行时状态会显示 EvidenceBank、Conclusion State 以及剩余的资源预算。 这些显式状态为已获取的证据和未解决的信息需求提供了有序的记录，同时包含了完整的交互历史。 累计读取预算仅计算整个回合中读取操作返回的源文本量。

A request failure that persists after the model client’s retry handling, including rejection of an oversized request, is recorded as model_request_failed and terminates the episode. Episodes that terminate without an accepted final answer are scored as incorrect.

paragraphs.en: AA-LCR-1.1 retains the document set supplied with each question, including its official grouping and document order. paragraphs.en: We use Codex CLI version 0.135.0 and Claude Code version 2.1.216. Claude Code and Codex inspect and modify workspace files through their native tools and local shell commands. RLM accesses documents programmatically through its Python REPL. LongHarness accesses documents through its defined search and reading operations and maintains evidence and conclusion states through explicit update actions. Table 8 summarizes these interfaces and resource limits. Each comparison uses the same questions, available documents, and backbone model, with the harness interface and execution protocol determining how the model interacts with the corpus. RLM operates in a local Python REPL whose variables persist across iterations within an episode. The model can inspect corpus files, process retrieved text programmatically, and invoke model subcalls through the REPL. The task prompt specifies the question, corpus location, and required answer format. Our benchmark adapter converts document paths to absolute paths accessible from the REPL and adds the benchmark-specific output contract. The root loop allows up to 30 iterations. The driver uses the library’s default maximum recursion depth of one, at which subcalls receive plain model completions rather than launching further REPL loops. Root and subcalls use the same backbone. If the returned answer does not satisfy the required output format, the adapter makes one additional call to the same model, instructed to copy the answer value verbatim into the required wrapper.

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 compares GLM-5.3-Flash trajectories for computing the geometric mean of 80 monthly Treasury expenditures in OfficeQA Pro V1. We randomly selected this case from Codex trajectories that failed the exact-match criterion. Steps in Figure 4 denote shell-command calls for Codex and policy actions for LongHarness . Codex locates the relevant table within 22 command calls but leaves missing values implicit, later making 103 consecutive backward reads ( unbounded exploration ). It computes 4958.09 using 4100 for May 1942, then recognizes the corrected value 4400 but retains the earlier result in its final answer. Replacing this operand yields the reference answer 4962.46. Codex therefore fails exact match but passes the 5% tolerance criterion, with a relative error of approximately 0.088%. This evidence-state drift illustrates a recognized correction that was not incorporated into the final computation.
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 比较了 GLM-5.3-Flash 在 OfficeQA Pro V1 中计算 80 个月期国债支出几何平均值时的推理轨迹。 我们从未能通过精确匹配标准的 Codex 推理轨迹中随机选择了这个案例。 图 4 中的步骤表示 Codex 执行的 shell 命令调用以及 LongHarness 执行的政策操作。 Codex 在 22 次命令调用内定位到了相关表格，但将缺失值视为隐含存在，随后进行了 103 次连续的向后读取（无边界探索）。 它使用 1942 年 5 月的数据 4100 计算得出 4958.09，之后识别出修正后的数值为 4400，但在最终答案中仍保留了之前的结果。 替换该操作数后，可得到参考答案 4962.46。 因此，Codex 未能通过精确匹配，但通过了 5% 的容差标准，相对误差约为 0.088%。 这种证据状态的偏移表明，一个已知的修正并未被纳入最终的计算过程。
